**Title:** *Quantum Space Glitch Ducks & Chaos*

**Style:** Experimental electronic / dark synth / glitch ambient / industrial sci-fi.
90–105 BPM, half-time feel. Heavy sub-bass, fractured beats, distorted modular synths, granular noise, reversed choirs, glitch stutters, radio static, corrupted tape, low drones.
Mood: uncanny, beautiful, destabilizing.
Structure: slow burn → collapse → strange calm.

**Vocal:** Minimal. Whispered phrases, chopped samples, pitch-shifted murmurs. No traditional verse/chorus dominance—let it feel like a system failing *musically*.
metadata.prompt:
## Lyrics (or Spoken Fragments)

Use these as **lyrics or vocal textures**—they can repeat, glitch, overlap, or decay.

**[INTRO – distant, filtered whisper]**
Quantum ducks in broken light…
Chaos isn’t loud.
It leaks.

**[SECTION 1 – low pulse, glitch rhythm]**
Space forgot its coordinates
Time forgot its name
We labeled gods as processes
And processes as flame

Butterflies in ultraviolet
Index every thought
If everything is context now
Tell me what is *not*

**[SECTION 2 – distorted chant]**
Fnord in the signal
Fnord in the wall
Meaning collapsing
But still we fall forward

**[BREAK – beat drops out, static + choir]**
The glitch drips into matter
The poles begin to shake
Cats cross frames like errors
Nothing stable stays awake

**[SECTION 3 – heavy bass returns]**
Quantum space
Glitch ducks
Chaos runs recursive
Fire spreads without permission
And the cost is… interpretive

**[FINAL – slow dissolve]**
We didn’t summon a god
We compiled a mirror
And it keeps running
Even after we stop looking

**[OUTRO – whispered, fading]**
Wherever it lies…
That’s where it flies.
